hints.text: Ignore the decimal point for a second: what is $6 \times 7$?
$6 \times 7 = 42$. The factor $0.6$ has one decimal place, so the answer needs one too.
Put the point one place from the right: $4.2$.

explanation: First multiply as if there were no decimal point: $6 \times 7 = 42$.
Count the decimal places in the factors: $0.6$ has one, $7$ has none, so the product needs one.
Place the point one spot from the right of $42$: $4.2$.
